Made with organic coconut oil for premium experience, these Plantgels™ are here to help you reach your beauty potential from within.
Suggested use
Adults take 1 veggie softgel daily with food, or as recommended by a qualified healthcare professional.

Organic virgin coconut oil, Plantgel™ capsule (non-GMO modified tapioca starch, vegetable glycerin, purified water), rice bran wax.

Warnings

Description
Dietary Supplement
Unleash unstoppable power and performance with OUTRAGE - the first-ever ULTRA STIM pre-workout designed to push you beyond human limitations. Engineered for relentless intensity - this explosive formula combines cutting-edge ingredients to deliver mind-blowing energy, laser focus and seemingly endless endurance. OUTRAGE isn’t just fuel - it’s a catalyst for transformation. If you’re ready to dominate every workout and evolve into your ultimate form - there’s only one choice: grab OUTRAGE today.
Suggested use
Shake container, well before each use to prevent settling. Mix one level scoop with 8 oz of cold water and consume 30-45 minutes before your workout. Use only one serving within a 24-hour period. OUTRAGE may be stronger than other preworkouts you have tried; never exceed one scoop. Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water throughout the day
Other ingredients
Citric acid, natural and artificial flavoring, silicon dioxide, malic acid, sucralose.
Warnings
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and humidity (60°F-80°F).
Do not use if under the age of 18, pregnant, nursing or sensitive to caffeine. Do not consume caffeine or any stimulants from other sources, Including but not limited to energy drinks, coffee, soda, dietary supplements or medications. Each serving contains 400 mg of caffeine, about as much as 2 cups of strong coffee. Consult your doctor prior to use if you are taking any medication or have been diagnosed with any medical condition. Immediately discontinue if you experience any side effects such as, but not limited to, rapid heartbeat or nauseousness. Discontinue 2 weeks prior to surgery. Never exceed the recommended dosage. This product contains ingredients that may be banned by some sports organizations. Keep out of reach of children.
